title: Herbal Juicy Irish Berry Tart
description: A delicious and healthy Irish dessert featuring filo pastry, mixed berries, and herbal notes, perfect for kids and diabetic-friendly diets. This tart combines the sweetness of berries with the crunch of filo pastry and a hint of herbal freshness.

ingredients.name: Mixed berries
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, such as blueberries, raspberries, and blackberries

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the chopped mint and lemon balm leaves.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed berries, honey, lemon juice, and herbal mixture.
Let the berry mixture ferment at room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour, or until it starts to release its juices and the flavors have melded together.
Meanwhile, layer the filo pastry sheets in a 9-inch tart pan, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Fill the pastry shell with the fermented berry mixture and smooth the top.
Fold the edges of the filo pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
Bake the tart for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with a dollop of kefir or yogurt and a sprinkle of vanilla extract.
